title: NTF-ELCAC cuts barangay dev’t program to P5M per village for 2027
summary: The National Task Force to End Local Communist Armed Conflict (NTF-ELCAC) slashed its proposed budget for its flagship project for next year in a bid to reach more “conflict-affected” barangays.
